description: Dockerfile ui-builder stage failed with TS2307 after warren-53a7 made the UI import src/client/ndjson.ts: the stage only copied src/core and src/ui, so bun run build:ui stayed green on full checkouts while the image build broke. Rule: every out-of-tree file listed in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include needs a matching COPY into the /build sibling tree (core/, client/).
resolution: Copy src/client/ndjson.ts + errors.ts into /build/client/ in the ui-builder stage; verify with docker build --target ui-builder .

description: [docker-quickstart-clone-root-outside-data-volume] The README docker-runtime quickstart mounts ONE volume and names it with WARREN_DATA_DIR (=/srv/warren), but src/projects/config.ts defaulted the clone root to a hardcoded /data/projects. Clones therefore landed outside the mounted volume, and every docker dispatch died binding the workspace into the agent container ('bind source path does not exist: .../<repo>/.git'). This broke the documented quickstart on every host OS, not just macOS. Fix (warren-5c42): derive the projects root from WARREN_DATA_DIR as <dataDir>/projects when WARREN_PROJECTS_DIR is unset, with /data as the dataDir fallback so the historical /data/projects default is byte-identical. Lesson: any warren-side path an agent runtime must also see has to derive from WARREN_DATA_DIR, the way src/runtime/local/paths.ts already did.
resolution: Fixed via warren-5c42 (PR #966): src/projects/config.ts derives the projects root from WARREN_DATA_DIR as <dataDir>/projects when WARREN_PROJECTS_DIR is unset, with /data as the dataDir fallback so the historical default still resolves.
